scope: User-requested parallel review of navigation/state, video/transcript resilience and reader UX, plus root integration fixes.

review_agents.name: Navigation stability review
review_agents.focus: Stale read/create/send fences, retained Search/draft/filter across views, independent readiness and merged history.

review_agents.name: Video/transcript review
review_agents.focus: Safe/recoverable thumbnails and video IDs, stable player, bounded malformed caption handling, cancellation/admission fences.

review_agents.name: Preview UX review
review_agents.focus: Video-only actions/copy, 44px controls, keyboard reading, safe-area spacing and focus containment.

live_cached_inspection.evidence_kind: Read-only cached live video/captions and view-navigation inspection; API mutations blocked by browser routing. No new search, transcript or model action.

limitations: No new live search, caption or model request in this review. Cached live caption data is existing single-video evidence.
Per-search text filters persist within this workspace session; source/date/last-tab preferences retain existing browser persistence.
Cancelling UI intent does not cancel already accepted server research; saved work/normal accounting remain.
Caption cancellation waits for already admitted work under existing transport timeouts rather than forcibly terminating a synchronous HTTP request.
Reader control/focus/responsive checks are targeted checks, not a comprehensive accessibility certification.
Existing shared model allowance remains blocked; no hold was erased or budget raised. General web search remains deferred.
